summary: Iteration 7 fix retest passed against the public API. The full focused suite passed 12/12. The 8-request identical-range create race was then repeated in two isolated runs; each produced exactly one 200, seven 409s, and schedule total_bookings=1. Conflict storms did not consume bill numbers: the next successful BNG auto bill was exactly previous + 1. Sequential, concurrent update, release, delete, schedule, revenue, prefix, and CRUD regressions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains 1,443 lines, above the 700-line maintainability threshold; split auth, bookings/reservations, stock, files, and stats into focused routers/services in a separate refactor.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 focused scenarios; create concurrency additionally passed 2/2 isolated repeats)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_I7_-prefixed stock and booking records for BNG/KLN, including concurrent create/update, bill-gap, release, schedule, revenue, and CRUD cases. Fixture cleanup deleted all tracked test bookings and stock items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The prior create race and conflict-generated bill gaps are no longer reproducible. Reuse test_iteration7_availability.py. It now verifies schedule count after the race, conflict-storm sequence continuity, concurrent status activation, failed-move reservation restoration, Returned/unlink/delete release paths, and prior regressions.
rca_of_the_issue: Verified fix behavior: create_booking atomically pushes a booked_ranges reservation before allocating an auto bill; conflicting requests fail at the reservation step with 409 and therefore never increment the counter. Reservation release/restore logic also preserved availability through tested PUT and DELETE paths.
